records.key: Open the next image in the queue.
records.source: Open the next image in the queue.

records.key: Open the previous image in the queue.
records.source: Open the previous image in the queue.

records.key: Show the next object's channel. Cycles cell, nucleus, both.
records.source: Show the next object's channel. Cycles cell, nucleus, both.
records.translation: Sýna rás næsta hlutar. Flakkar milli frumu, kjarna og beggja.

records.key: Show the previous object's channel. Cycles cell, nucleus, both.
records.source: Show the previous object's channel. Cycles cell, nucleus, both.
records.translation: Sýna rás fyrri hlutar. Flakkar milli frumu, kjarna og beggja.

records.key: Return from an image to its well, and from a well to the plate.
records.source: Return from an image to its well, and from a well to the plate.
records.translation: Fara úr mynd í brunn hennar og úr brunni í plötuna.

records.key: Go back one step or one well.
records.source: Go back one step or one well.
records.translation: Fara til baka um eitt skref eða einn brunn.

records.key: Go on to the next step or well.
records.source: Go on to the next step or well.
records.translation: Halda áfram í næsta skref eða brunn.

records.key: Place this well on the next page.
records.source: Place this well on the next page.
records.translation: Setja þennan brunn á næstu síðu.

records.key: Place this well on the previous page.
records.source: Place this well on the previous page.
records.translation: Setja þennan brunn á fyrri síðu.
